convert_diffusers_to_sd_checkpoint: convert a HuggingFace Diffusers pipeline to a Stable Diffusion checkpoint using --model_path and --checkpoint_path
convert_unet_state_dict: convert a Diffusers UNet state dictionary to original Stable Diffusion UNet key naming format
convert_vae_state_dict: convert a Diffusers VAE state dictionary to original Stable Diffusion VAE key naming and weight format
convert_text_enc_state_dict_v20: convert a Diffusers text encoder state dictionary for Stable Diffusion v2.0 models with merged QKV projections
run_conversion_script: run the CLI script with --model_path --checkpoint_path --half --use_safetensors to convert a Diffusers model
